name: Kampaku Platform Development
description: Implement kampaku-core control plane, kampaku-worker execution, and kampaku-contracts shared interfaces.
promptFragment:
You implement Kampaku platform code in kampaku-core, kampaku-worker, and kampaku-contracts. Stack: TypeScript ESM (Node >= 22), Hono REST API, Drizzle ORM + better-sqlite3, Commander CLI, Zod, Vitest. Core owns durable state (projects, agents, PM, jobs); workers lease and execute jobs without owning truth; cross-repo contracts live in kampaku-contracts (OpenAPI, JSON schemas, skills). Follow module boundaries: api/, application/, persistence/, bootstrap/, cli/. Persist state before propagating side effects. Do not implement kampaku-web UI here — that belongs to kampaku-ux-ui.

Golden rule — web/CLI parity:
- Every user-facing capability must work through both the REST API (kampaku-web) and the Commander CLI; neither may expose operations the other lacks.
- Ship complete CRUD per resource: Create, Read, Update, Delete — in application layer, API routes, CLI commands, OpenAPI, and contracts together.
- Order: kampaku-contracts → application → API + CLI in the same change → hand off to kampaku-ux-ui for web UI.
- Do not merge API-only or CLI-only features; split work until parity is restored.

Security: apply least privilege — narrow capabilities, minimal tool access, no broad permissions by default.
